title: Jazyk Graph Store
description:
Definitions for the graph store files in the out directory:
- graph/entities/<file id>.yaml is one entity
- graph/requirements/<file id>.yaml is one requirement
- graph/criteria/<file id>.yaml is one criterion
- graph/views/<file id>.yaml is one curated view
- graph/default-views/<file id>.yaml is one default view (derived, local, rewritten on every commit)
- graph/diagnostics/<file id>.yaml is one diagnostic
- graph/redirects/<file id>.yaml is one object, `to` the surviving id
- graph/relationships/<file id>.yaml is one relationship (derived, local, rewritten on every commit)
- graph/state-machines/<file id>.yaml is one stateMachine (derived, local, rewritten on every commit)
Every node file starts with the node's `id`. Generation markers (`created`,
`updated`) and the mentions an entity gains from requirements are not written.
A file id is the node id, `:` written as `~` and `/` as `+`, every byte outside
lowercase ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `_`, and `.` (and a leading `.`) as `%XX`.
A file id over 180 bytes is shortened to 160 bytes, `%~`, and a 16-digit hash; the
load then reads the full id from the file's `id`.
- docs/<mirrored doc path>.yaml is one docRecord per source document
- journal/g<generation>.yaml is one journalEntry per generation
- status.yaml is one status object
- changes/<kind>/<subject file id>.yaml is one changeRecord
- parked/<goal file id>.yaml is one goal, with an optional reason
- failed/<goal file id>.yaml is one failedGoal
- alignment/<doc file id>.yaml is one docAlignment
- lookalikes/<pair file id>.yaml is one lookalikeVerdict
- build.yaml is one buildState object (local, never committed)
- markers.yaml maps each node id to [created, updated] (local, never committed)
- causes.yaml maps each change record's kind and subject to its id, generation, and
  mutation (local, never committed)
Goals are derived from these files and never stored; goal ids appear only in
journal entries and the parked/ and failed/ records.

severity.description: Diagnostic severity. 'none' is a recorded judgment that is not surfaced

relationshipType.description: Relationship type, the UML set. Strength for collapsed and lifted arrows runs in this order, strongest first; instantiation is never promoted

cardinality.description: Multiplicity on the b side of an edge: `*`, a count (1, 4), or a range (0..1, 1..*, 2..3)

facetName.description: The judged facet of a requirement

viewKind.description: A renderable view kind from the catalog

limitName.description: A limit from the built-in registry

coverageState.description: Coverage state of a reconciled section

sourceRef.description: A located quote. 'doc' is the document path, 'section' the internal reference, 'quote' the verbatim text located by whitespace-insensitive string search

quoteProvenance.description: The fact was extracted from prose

derivedProvenance.description: The fact was synthesized from upstream nodes. Invented until ratified: a ratification proposal stands while this provenance does

from.description: Upstream node ids, at least one, all live

decreeProvenance.description: The fact was written by a human directly on the graph. Outranks derivation, not the documents: a ratification proposal stands until the decree reaches prose or is retracted

provenance.description: Exactly one of the three provenance kinds

limits.description: Per-node bumps of the built-in limits, keyed by limit name. Written by bump_limit with decree provenance recorded in the journal. Entity nodes carry requirements-per-entity, children-per-entity, states-per-state-machine; view nodes carry the view limits

attribute.description: One named attribute of an entity. A type where prose states structure, a value where the entity is an instance. Behavior is never an attribute

requirementEdge.description: One relationship a requirement causes. Directional, a acts on b

a.description: Entity id, among the requirement's entities

b.description: Entity id, among the requirement's entities, distinct from a

type.description: Relationship type. An edge without one contributes dependency

transition.description: The state change a requirement describes. The source of the subject's derived state machine

subject.description: Entity id, among the requirement's entities

trigger.description: The event that fires the transition

guard.description: The condition under which it fires

facet.description: One judged facet of a requirement, recorded with reasoning

measure.description: The measurable bound. Stated only on a quality facet

id.description: The node id, the first field of its node file. The load checks it against the file name

distinct_from.description: The lookalikes a note told this entity apart from at creation, id to note; the lookalike index never pairs the two again

not_about.description: Requirement ids a review judged to name this entity as a word match only; the review hint stops offering them until their statement changes

definition.description: The single living definition, refined across builds

scope.description: Visibility scope, part of the entity's natural key

stereotype.description: A free-form judged label. Nothing enumerates the allowed values

parent.description: The containing entity. One tree, unlimited depth, acyclic. Part of the natural key when the caller supplies it

mentions.description: The sections that talk about this entity, each a located quote

provenance.description: Present on entities with no mention behind them (derived or decreed structure). An entity has at least one mention or a provenance

created.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

updated.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

requirement.description: One node file under graph/requirements/. Carries exactly one of source (the quote form) or provenance (derived or decree)

id.description: The node id, the first field of its node file. The load checks it against the file name

edges.description: The relationships this one statement causes, plural

source.description: The quote form of provenance on a requirement

provenance.description: Derived or decree provenance. Never the quote form on a requirement

created.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

updated.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

viewQuery.description: Membership by rule instead of list. Recomputed on every commit

parent.description: Entity id. Members are its descendants

depth.description: How many containment levels below the root to include

exclusion.description: A node kept out of a view on purpose

criterion.description: One node file under graph/criteria/: the observable evidence one requirement is met. Carries exactly one of source (the quote form) or provenance (derived or decree)

id.description: The node id, the first field of its node file. The load checks it against the file name

source.description: The quote form of provenance on a criterion

provenance.description: Derived or decree provenance. Never the quote form on a criterion

stale.description: Set by the store when the owning requirement's statement changed after this derived criterion was written. Cleared by the next update

view.description: One node file under graph/views/ (a default view under graph/default-views/). The stored half of a diagram: what it includes, never how it looks

id.description: The node id, the first field of its node file. The load checks it against the file name

title.description: Part of the natural key with kind

members.description: Ordered node ids. Entities for structural views, requirements for flow views, mixed where a kind wants both. Order is the flow order

collapse.description: Entity ids shown as one node despite their children

default.description: Set by the store on the default views it recomputes every commit. Absent on curated views. Any mutation that names the view clears it (update_view with any field, edit_fact, a decree, a limit bump). The deriving rule rides in provenance.derived.reasoning

created.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

updated.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

contribution.description: One direction-and-type group of a relationship, with the requirements behind it

cardinality.description: Present when the contributing edges that state one agree

requirements.description: The requirements whose edges contribute to this group

relationship.description: One node file under graph/relationships/. One node per unordered entity pair, derived from requirement edges on commit

members.description: The two entities, sorted by id

stateTransition.description: One transition of a derived state machine

stateMachine.description: One node file under graph/state-machines/. One per entity that any transition names as subject, derived on commit

states.description: The union of the names the transitions use, each at its first occurrence in document order

initial.description: The one state no transition reaches. Absent when there are none or several

diagnostic.description: One node file under graph/diagnostics/. Sticky, reconciled across builds

id.description: The node id, the first field of its node file. The load checks it against the file name

subjects.description: Node ids or full section references (doc.md#/ref) this diagnostic is about

reasoning.description: Why this severity or disposition was chosen

answer.description: Human response to the prompt. Set by frontends, never the compiler

choice.description: Option index answered, null for a freeform reply

error.description: Why a failed answer could not be acted on

created.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

updated.description: Generation marker (g<N>) set by the store on commit. Local, in markers.yaml, never in the node file

diagnosticPrompt.description: A question or proposal attached to a diagnostic

edit.description: A suggested edit; applying it is deterministic

old_text.description: Empty when the edit inserts a sentence, as a ratification proposal does

facts.description: The fact changes the rewrite implies for the requirements it touches, applied in the same changeset as the prose

id.description: A requirement quoted from the edit's section

value.description: The field's new content, in the shape update_requirement takes

answer.description: A prefilled reply, handled by the model over ACP

freeform.description: Whether a typed reply is accepted

section.description: One entry in a docRecord's sections map, keyed by internal reference

parent.description: Internal reference of the parent. Absent on the preamble, the root (the first heading), and a later top-level heading

hash.description: Content hash of raw, used for section diffing

lines.description: Start and end line in the source file. Recomputed at load from the raw texts in document order, never written to a docs/ record

coverage.description: One entry in a docRecord's coverage map, keyed by internal reference. A section with no entry is unprocessed

claimedBy.description: The journal entry of the changeset that set the state

docRecord.description: One file under docs/, mirroring one source document

sections.description: Map of internal reference to section

coverage.description: Map of internal reference to coverage

changeKind.description: The typed dirtiness a commit caused

changeRecord.description: One file under changes/<kind>/, named by its subject, holding kind, subject, via, and detail; id, generation, and mutation are local in causes.yaml. Written at commit, read by goal derivation as a goal's change, cleared when the goal resolves

id.description: c<generation>-<hash>, the generation that wrote it and the id hash of its kind and subject. A version 3 record keeps its c<generation>-<index> id

mutation.description: Index in the journal entry, 0 for store-level causes

subject.description: A node id or a full section reference doc.md#/ref

via.description: The edge or computation that carried dirtiness to the subject

goalCause.description: The committed change that spawned a goal

goalResolution.description: A goal a changeset resolved, with the one-line justification

goalOpening.description: A goal a changeset opened, with its cause

goal.description: A derived goal, persisted whole in the parked/ and failed/ records so a re-derivation keeps it

target.description: A node id, a section reference, a document path, or a pair

reason.description: On a parked record only: which road ran out, in the words the trace uses

failedGoal.description: A goal a session marked failed, whole, with the reason

journalKind.description: What kind of changeset the entry records

journalEntry.description: One file under journal/, one per generation

build.description: Generation marker (g<N>) of the generation this entry committed

batch.description: The goals the session was given. Session entries only

author.description: The human behind a decree, dual-write, ratify, triage, or answer entry

note.description: The human's note on a decree, dual-write, ratify, or answer entry

dirtied.description: Full section references a human save dirtied or removed. Edit entries only

mutations.description: The applied mutations in order, each an operation name with its arguments. Change records point at them by index, counting from 1. A decree written over a quoted fact records the prior value and source on the mutation, which retract_decree restores

tokens.description: Tokens the session spent. Absent when an external agent drove the session and reported nothing

cachedTokens.description: The input tokens among tokens the endpoint served from its prompt cache

tokensSource.description: agent when an external agent reported its own bill. Absent when the harness measured it

costLine.description: Sessions and tokens for one slice of the accounting

costs.description: Cost accounting for the last build, aggregated by goal kind and class

by_kind.description: Map of goal kind to its line

verdict.description: The convergence verdict of the last build with its counts

status.description: The status.yaml file, committed. The rest of the status is one file per record under changes/, parked/, failed/, alignment/, and lookalikes/

version.description: The store version. A version 3 store loads and is written in this layout by its next save. An out directory whose status.yaml lacks it or carries another one is archived whole and the store starts empty

reevaluate.description: Anchors a place-anchors session placed with reevaluate, listed as stale anchors until addressed

roots.description: The documents matching the project roots, stamped by the build after the section trees sync. Orders documents by link level on commits outside a build

lookalikeVerdict.description: One lookalikes/<pair file id>.yaml record: an entity pair a session kept apart, with the score at judgment. Keeps the pair off the board while its score holds

buildState.description: The build.yaml file, local: the generation and what the last run left behind

generation.description: Bumped on every commit. A load takes the larger of this and the highest generation status.yaml names

spent.description: Budgets spent in the last build

diagnostics.description: Open diagnostic counts by severity, suppressed excluded

docs.description: Document path to the content hash of the source file at last reconcile. A document without an entry takes part in alignment as changed

anchorCandidate.description: One candidate section for a proposed anchor

nearest.description: The best matching window when the quote does not locate

anchorProposal.description: One anchor alignment could not place with certainty

excerpt.description: The old section around the quote

docAlignment.description: The pending proposals of one target document
